title: foliwake.remote.json version 3
description: Optional overrides of an app configured by FOLIWAKE_URL: the site's discovery document (/.well-known/foliwake.json) gives its origins and media CDN; this file holds the app's own settings and the NAMES of the variables holding credentials. No secrets. The TypeScript parser (@foliwake/server/resolve) is the authority; test/server-config-v3.test.js keeps both in step.

site.description: Checked against the discovery document's site.

preview.description: Default auth: Basic, user preview, password from FOLIWAKE_PREVIEW_TOKEN.

pages.description: Page globs the app may read (query-index grammar: [a-z0-9_-] literals, * within a segment, ** as a whole segment; /x/** also matches /x).

proxies.description: App-origin URL prefixes of the proxies. Not /, /_next, /api, /code, /media or below them; code and media differ and neither is inside the other.

entry.description: Path of the blocks module inside a code release; absent or null: bodies stay static.

media.description: Live pictures through a transforming host (preview pictures always go through the media proxy).

revalidate.description: Seconds before a cached envelope is stale (stale-while-revalidate; expire is 24 h).

app.description: The app's own decisions; every key is optional. Without pages: ["/**"] (required when live uses a service token). Without blocks: each page's code release names its blocks module (X-Foliwake-Blocks). Without media: the discovery document's media CDN, if any.

passwordEnv.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding the password.

serviceTokenAuth.description: Each request carries a fresh ES256 JWT for its exact path (exp = iat + 60), signed with the private key in privateKeyEnv; the delivery checks it with the public key of kid.

issuer.description: The iss the delivery expects (its TOKEN_ISSUER).

kid.description: The key id of the public key the delivery holds.

privateKeyEnv.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding the ES256 private key as JWK JSON text.
